game.title: Half-Life: Alyx
game.blurb: Sci-fi VR first-person shooter from Valve Software, released 2020-03-23. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Opening Stretch
chapters.summary: The start of the story through the quarantine zone and the train yard, including the shotgun. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Hotel, the Plant and the Distillery
chapters.summary: The middle of the story: the station street, the hotel, the processing plant and the distillery, including the SMG. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Zoo, the Water Tower and the Vault
chapters.summary: The last stretch: the zoo, the tanker yard, the water tower, the parking garage, the vault and the ending. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Gravity Gloves, Multitool and Combat
chapters.summary: Looting, smashing crates, weapon upgrades, gravity-glove tricks, hacking a tripmine and tougher kills.

chapters.title: Side Secrets and Easter Eggs
chapters.summary: Bottles, the snark, the playground, the gnome and other optional moments, many of them hidden.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 546560)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Half-Life:_Alyx
Fandom (half-life.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://half-life.fandom.com/wiki/Half-Life:_Alyx
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a stub page "Half-Life: Alyx" (completion stage 0, marked "Perfect stub article"); it links Gameplay, Walkthrough and Table of Contents subpages but none is written, so nothing was used. half-life.fandom.com answers the API under "Half-Life: Alyx" with about 126 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema gives no game name for app 546560; the store list confirms it. 25 of 42 Steam achievements are hidden. Steam API names group them: TRACK_A1 to TRACK_A5 with place codes (for example A2_QUARANTINE_ENTRANCE, A3_HOTEL_LOBBY_BASEMENT, A4_C17_ZOO, A5_VAULT, A5_ENDING), so the three story chapters follow those codes (A1 and A2, A3, A4 and A5) and the summaries name places from them; TRAINING and SKILL names went to the gloves and combat chapter; SIDE, HIDDEN and GLOBAL names went to side secrets, except "Safe Trip" (hack a tripmine with the multitool), which was put with the gloves and multitool. RAWG lists PC as the only platform.
